function_v0.doc:
Deploys a wallet with `(signers, policies)` as its constructor
arguments and returns its address. The salt is the SHA-256 of their
XDR, so the address commits to the wallet's signers: anyone may call
this, and a second deploy of the same arguments fails.
function_v0.name: deploy

function_v0.doc: Pins the smart-account wasm, which must already be uploaded. There is\nno way to change it: a new wasm is a new factory.
function_v0.name: __constructor

function_v0.doc: Returns the address `deploy` creates for these arguments, whether or\nnot the wallet exists yet.
function_v0.name: predict_address

udt_union_v0.doc: Represents different types of signers in the smart account system.
udt_union_v0.name: Signer

tuple_v0.doc:
A delegated signer, any contract or account address, authenticated
through `require_auth_for_args((preimage,))`. Transaction simulation
does not return this nested authorization entry, because the call
happens inside `__check_auth`. Clients add it manually: an entry for
the delegated address whose root invocation is `__check_auth` on the
smart account with the [`AuthDigestPreimage`] as its single argument.
See `src/smart_account/test/auth_entries.rs` for a reference
construction.
tuple_v0.name: Delegated

tuple_v0.doc: An external signer with custom verification logic.\nContains the verifier contract address and the public key data.
tuple_v0.name: External
